name: Listening for meaning
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners listen actively and identify key points in spoken ideas.

name: Collaborative discussion
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners build on contributions and use talk to shape shared understanding.

name: Presenting information
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners organise and communicate information clearly for a chosen audience.

name: Locating information
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners find relevant details from texts diagrams sources and digital materials.

name: Inference and deduction
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners use evidence to read beyond obvious information and justify interpretations.
example_classroom_opportunities: {Character evidence grid,Historical source inference,Scientific explanation reading}

name: Comparing sources
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners compare viewpoints reliability and purpose across sources.
example_classroom_opportunities: {News comparison,Primary and secondary source check,Website reliability review}

name: Planning writing
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners plan structure content and sequence before producing written work.

name: Technical accuracy
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners edit spelling punctuation grammar and vocabulary choices.

name: Audience and purpose
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners adapt tone register and form to suit the intended reader.

name: Use of calculation
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners choose and apply calculations in meaningful subject contexts.

name: Collecting data
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners gather data fairly and record it in usable forms.

name: Interpreting trends
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners describe patterns anomalies and relationships in data.
example_classroom_opportunities: {Climate trend discussion,Performance data story,Population graph analysis}

name: Creating digital content
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners combine media and tools to create purposeful digital outcomes.

name: Evaluating outputs
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners review digital work against purpose and make improvements.

name: Culture and community
teacher_friendly_explanation: Learners investigate cultures languages and communities in Wales and beyond.
